RESPONSIBILITIES:
Usage of FEA and other analytical tools to define mold shapes which respect internal homologation, tireline, government/regulatory, and industrial requirements. Analytical studies using FEA to determine tire performance based upon variations in design and/or usage. Assessments of proposed scenarios during a tireline or OE development project feasibility study using FEA and other analytical techniques. Presentation of simulation results and consultation for design decisions both inside and outside of design event activities. Able to perform responsibilities of Key-user, Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.. on need basis. Engagement in technical exchanges (Tech club & Focus group participation, etc). Adhering to the company policies. Meet the deadline defined for each project. Knowledge Sharing: Creation of reports regarding golden nuggets or fundamental knowledge for new design rules and understandings of tire mechanics and analysis methods. Documentation of simulation methods and best practices (Lv-1). Transmission of knowledge and development of people in simulation tools/practices through teaching in the Tire Design school and mentoring/training new analysts and tire designers. Progress and Collaboration: Engage in the development and testing of new simulation tools, providing valuable feedback to improve these resources. Serve as a key liaison across different global regions in this field, ensuring alignment and excellence in our collaborative efforts. title: Legal Counsel - Africa & Middle East
jobDescription:
Legal Counsel
- Africa & Middle East
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
-
- We are seeking a highly competent, commercially astute, and motivated Legal Counsel to join our dynamic egal team, supporting the Africa and Middle East region within the AIM (Africa, India, Middle East and Sri Lanka) Region of the Michelin Group. The ideal candidate will have 10–12 years of post-qualification experience, with strong expertise in commercial and corporate law, agency and distributorship arrangements, joint ventures, mediation and dispute resolution, corporate governance, and legal operations. The Legal Counsel for the Africa and Middle East region will be responsible for ensuring the Group's legal, governance, and ethical compliance across its entities, including joint ventures and recently acquired businesses, within the designated geographical perimeter. The role involves providing pragmatic and commercially focused legal advice, identifying and mitigating legal risks, supporting strategic business initiatives, and partnering with internal stakeholders across a broad range of legal and operational matters. The incumbent will also help ensure that business activities are conducted in compliance with applicable local laws and regulations, while remaining aligned with Michelin's global legal, ethics, and compliance framework. Main Missions:
1. Legal Advisory and Regulatory Compliance- Monitor and interpret applicable laws and regulations across the region (notably UAE, KSA & other GCC countries, Morocco, South Africa, Nigeria) and advise the Business. Provide timely, accurate, and business-oriented legal advice to all internal stakeholders across various domains of law including commercial law, antitrust, consumer protection, privacy, labor, business ethics, and all other regulatory matters. Anticipate legal risks and propose practical and strategic mitigation measures that safeguard the company’s interests while enabling business ambitions. Serve as the first point of contact for legal consultations across the region and ensure legal risks are properly managed. Support business negotiations with third parties, administrations, and partners, ensuring legal robustness in all agreements.
2. Contract Management and Negotiations- Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial contracts including franchise, distribution, supply, partnership, licensing, and marketing agreements. Serve as the primary legal point of contact for the Lifestyle business line and provide focused support to the Mining business line. Ensure alignment of regional contracts with Group templates (including those of the business lines), internal policies, and local legal frameworks. Ensure effective implementation and continuous use of the Contract Lifecycle Management tool in the region.
3. Ethics and Compliance Programs- Ensure implementation and enforcement of Group compliance programs in the region, including without limitation those pertaining to anti-corruption, antitrust, privacy, and export control. Serve as the primary point of contact for third-party payment processes.
4. Labor Law and HR Support- Advise HR teams on labor law issues, including disciplinary processes, employment contract compliance, non-compete enforcement, and local labor regulation updates. Review and support the drafting and updating of HR policies (e.g. attendance policies, internal regulations) to ensure legal soundness and applicability.
5. Export Control Compliance- Act as liaison between business teams and the export control department. Ensure that all transactions, clients, and contracts comply with export control regulations. Negotiate and manage export control clauses in contracts and provide support in sensitive case requiring legal advice.
6. Litigation Management- Supervise litigation matters in the region in collaboration with external counsel. Manage selected cases efficiently, ensuring efficient handling and proper alignment with company strategy and risk tolerance.
7. Internal Training and Knowledge Sharing- Train internal teams on compliance and relevant legal topics (antitrust, privacy, marketing and communications, anticorruption, etc.) Translate complex legal concepts into accessible and practical guidance to build legal literacy within the business.
8. Company Secretarial and Corporate Governance Support entities across the Africa and Middle East region in relation to corporate governance, board and committee processes, and company secretarial compliance requirements, as required. Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable corporate governance standards, statutory obligations, and internal Group governance policies.
9. Miscellaneous Support the Group Intellectual Property team on intellectual property matters affecting the Africa and Middle East region, as required. Lead and support ethics investigations across the Africa and Middle East entities, as required, ensuring adherence to the Group's ethics, compliance, and investigation protocols. Undertake such other legal, compliance, governance, or strategic projects and responsibilities as may be assigned from time to time. Support public affairs activities, including monitoring regulatory developments relevant to the business and coordinating engagement with public authorities and industry stakeholders, if required. Key Expected Achievements- Regional Compliance: Ensure legal and regulatory compliance of all entities and operations in the Africa and Middle East region. Effective Legal Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify, assess, and manage legal risks across all functions and business lines. Strategic Legal Partner: Provide pragmatic, business-friendly legal advice that enables growth while protecting the company’s interests. Contractual Excellence: Secure favorable outcomes in negotiations and ensure the legal integrity of commercial agreements. Compliance Program Implementation: Successfully roll out and maintain Group compliance programs (e.g. anti-corruption, antitrust, privacy, export control) within the perimeter. Ethical Governance: Actively contribute to a strong culture of ethics and compliance by supporting governance structures such as the Ethics Committee. Labor Law Support: Ensure HR processes (i.e. disciplinary processes) and documentation (i.e. internal regulations) are legally compliant. Litigation Oversight: Ensure litigation cases are efficiently and properly managed, minimizing exposure and aligning with company objectives. Internal Capability Building: Improve internal understanding of legal and compliance obligations through training, clear communication, and practical advice. Autonomous Delivery with Strategic Reporting: Deliver responsibilities independently while keeping the General Counsel informed on high-priority topics. Qualifications- A bachelor’s degree in law from a reputed law school or university. A master’s degree in law is preferred but not mandatory. 10-12 years of relevant experience in legal roles. Demonstrated experience in a similar role within a corporate legal department, with a strong understanding of commercial and corporate/legal affairs Avancer ensemble, un engagement réciproque et responsable : Rejoindre Michelin c’est vous développer dans une entreprise où respect, dialogue, passion et confiance sont la clé de nos relations avec nos employés. title: Solution Architect- Data and AI
jobDescription: Own architectural decisions (ADRs), reference blueprints, and target-state designs; arbitrate trade-offs on latency, cost, and scalability. Architect end-to-end data and AI solutions: medallion Lakehouse (Bronze/Silver/Gold) on ADLS Gen2 + Delta Lake, streaming ingestion, ML deployment pipelines. Optimize large-scale Py Spark/Databricks workloads — partitioning, AQE, skew handling, Photon, cluster tuning. Design data models across Postgre SQL, nowflake (Kimball, Data Vault 2.0, denormalized serving). Productionize ML/DL models via Azure ML, AKS, Functions; expose Fast API endpoints for batch and real-time inference. Enforce security and compliance — Entra ID, Key Vault, PII, Unity Catalog / Purview, GDPR. Build CI/CD and MLOps pipelines (Azure Dev Ops, Terraform/Bicep, MLflow); instrument observability. Data Modeling Architecture/Design must also be done by Data and AI Solution Architect This typically includes STAR SCHEMA Design, Normalization/Denormalization Data Patterns, etc. Ability to evaluate and recommend which platform component would be best fit for given requirement. Example: Decide between Postgres Db/Mongo Db, Decide between ODAP/One System Platform, etc. Implementation of Continuous Architecture Know how about BI domain + AI domains (NLP, GEN A, RAG, Forecasting, Computer Vision, Agentic AI, LLM) average or above average knowledge of concepts and internal technicalities. Coach delivery teams, align with Data Science, Product, QA, and Platform leads, and contribute to the CDO's data policy. Operate hands-on when needed — ingestion, cleansing, validation, repository design, root-cause analysis. Must-Have Advanced Python, Py Spark, SQL Expert in Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark Structured Streaming Strong Azure stack: ADLS Gen2, ADF, Synapse, Azure ML, AKS, Event Hubs, Key Vault Proven design of medallion Lakehouse architectures at TB–PB scale Deep DB expertise: Postgre SQL, Synapse, Snowflake, ADLS ML/DL fluency: scikit-learn, Tensor Flow, Py Torch, MLflow Hands-on PII/GDPR data handling and cloud security CI/CD & MLOps: Azure Dev Ops or Git Hub Actions, Terraform/Bicep, Docker, Kubernetes Behavioural Competencies : Communication Clarity Produces clear, concise architecture documents, runbooks and presentation materials appropriate to the audience. Continuous Learning & Curiosity Keeping up with industry advances,trends and applies relevant innovations pragmatically. Risk Awareness & Security Mindset Recognizing operational, security, privacy and model-risk exposures and designs to mitigate them. Problem-Solving & Complexity Management Decomposes ambiguous, large-scale problems into manageable components and pragmatic solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Enablement Works effectively across disciplines and empowers teams to deliver. Stakeholder Management & Influence Builds trust with business leaders, product owners, legal, security and engineering; influences decisions without direct authority. Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen Understands business drivers and shapes AI solutions that deliver measurable value and align with long-term strategy. Experience 10–15 years in data architecture, data engineering/data science. Demonstrated delivery of at least one enterprise Lakehouse and one production AI/ML solution.
